title: Bug:[chassis] ipfwd testcase add/del route command failure in multiAsics chassis
author: mannytaheri
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

ipfwd testcase add/del route command failure in multiAsics chassis 

This failure is caused by sonic-utils -  [#4269](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4269).


board201:~$ sudo ip netns exec asic0 config route add prefix 201.1.1.1/32 nexthop 10.0.0.77
Usage: config route [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Try 'config route -h' for help.

Error: Missing option '-n' / '--namespace'. Choose from:
        asic0

Summary:
Fix `test_dip_sip.py` static route commands failing on multi-ASIC platforms due to the config route CLI now requiring `-n/--namespace.`
Fixes #23621 

### Type of change

<!--

- [x] Bug fix

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The `config route` CLI now requires `-n/--namespace` on multi-ASIC platforms after sonic-utilities [#4269](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4269). 
The previous approach of wrapping commands with `sudo ip netns exec <namespace>` no longer works since the `config route` Click group enforces the `-n` option directly.
#### How did you do it?
- run config route from the host namespace using `-n <namespace>` instead of entering the ASIC namespace via `ip netns exec`
- use the existing `SonicAsic.cli_ns_option` property to build the namespace argument
#### How did you verify/test it?
Run `ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py` on single-asic and multi-asic platforms

comments.author: yxieca
comments.body:
@vishal-nokia Can you elaborate more on how the previous multi-asic handling code suddenly stopped working?

If we need to make this change, then how many other places we need to make the similar update? - the answer to this question might depend on the first question.

comments.author: vishal-nokia
comments.body:
@yxieca As part of my earlier PR #19931, I did two things:

- Added multi-asic support 
- Refactored the code to use the SONiC CLI (`config route add/del`) instead of Linux iproute2 commands (`ip route add/del`)

At the time, `config route` did not have a `-n <namespace>` option, so I  ran it in an ASIC namespace using `ip netns exec <namespace> config route` . sonic-net/sonic-utilities#4269 then added the `-n <namespace>` option to the `config route` Click group and made it mandatory on multi-asic platforms, which broke the older `ip netns exec` approach. This PR fixes that by using `config route add/del -n <namespace>` from the host namespace instead.

Regarding scope of impact: places still using raw `ip route add/del` are unaffected. I searched the codebase for other occurrences of ip netns exec ... config route and found one other place: [tests/qos/qos_sai_base.py line 2962](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/qos/qos_sai_base.py#L2962), used by the `testQosSaiFullMeshTrafficSanity` test. However, it only runs on `cisco-8000` platforms so I'm not sure if it's affected.

comments.author: vishal-nokia
comments.body:
@anamehra @vmittal-msft  This PR should not be cherry-picked to 2511.

It will cause a regression since the sonic-utilities PR [#4269](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4269) is not in 2511.
That PR adds a `-n/--namespace` option to `config route` and makes it required on multi-asic platforms.
This change is only in master as of now.
The 2511 image does not recognise the `-n` flag for the same command.

2511:
``` bash
admin@ixre-egl-board1:~$ sudo config route -n asic0 -h
Usage: config route [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Try 'config route -h' for help.

Error: No such option: -n
```

Master:
``` bash
admin@ixre-egl-board3:~$ sudo config route -h
Usage: config route [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  route-related configuration tasks

Options:
  -n, --namespace [asic0|asic1]  Namespace name  [required]
  -h, -?, --help                 Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  add  Add route command
  del  Del route command
```
Please check.

comments.author: vishal-nokia
comments.body:
@peterbailey-arista @anamehra I'd recommend reverting this from 202511 rather than backporting sonic-utilities #4269.

Backporting sonic-utilities [#4269](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4269) to 202511 is riskier since it's part of a larger effort ([sonic-net/SONiC#2288](https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/pull/2288)). Cherry-picking `#4269` in isolation could leave 202511 in a half-applied state and introduce regressions elsewhere.
